fields: h, intro, cols [role, what you do, must have, base and travel, pay and opening], rows (strings; the last cell "pay · status"). Best for 1 to 6 roles (one or two rows of three); more roles still draw.
best_for: RoleLoop sets a table of roles as the bays of one twin-wall pipe loop on the navy band: the loop meanders over one role card and under the next and runs back on the second row, and each role's branch off the loop carries a valve that reads open or closed only when the role's own copy says so.
